item.title: 50s Spanish Titling Face with hook-ish 'U'
item.description: I came across this a few years ago in a museum exhibiting a few pages from a 1950s edition of Picasso’s bullfight drawings. Being no fan of either Picasso or bullfighting, the thing I found most interesting about this was the titling face used on the front page, particularly its U, which has its »straight« top part and its curved bottom clearly separated, and this separation empasised by serif-like hook-ish embellishments on both sides.
